text: 三安光电：8月31日，公司董事长林志强先生增持公司股份77万股，约占公司总股本的0.02%，增持金额人民币997.7万元
text_en: Sanan Optoelectronics: On August 31, the company's chairman, Mr. Lin Zhiqiang, increased his stake in the company by 770,000 shares, representing approximately 0.02% of the company's total shares, for a total amount of RMB 9.977 million.
